summary: Finite omission models show that none of the eight tested act/potency premises follows from the other seven, even with sensible motion and a well-founded per-se series. This is independence from those inputs only, not metaphysical possibility or a proof that no further premises over the vocabulary could suffice. No target is discharged. See docs/act-potency-theory.md, Findings 1–2.
